items.scope: Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
NVIDIA issues only.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
All current products/software/apps made by Logitech, Ultimate Ears, Jaybird, Streamlabs, Logitech G, Logicool, Blue, and Astro Gaming.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
OPPO devices only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
ABB issues only.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.
Vulnerabilities in all Ubiquiti products and products of Ubiquiti subsidiaries only.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in commercial off-the-shelf software (COTS) selected for inclusion in the NATO Approved Software List (A2SL) that are not in the scope of another CNA.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.

All products for Haverford Systems brands, PTZOptics and HuddleCamHD (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Haverford Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
Zyxel products issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
QNAP issues only.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
Vulnerabilities in software published and maintained by Progress Software Corporation.
JetBrains products only.
All NLnet Labs projects.
